title: Public, internal, confidential: how our data classification works
concept: One long white sheet of monoline drawings. Every item is a single grey dashed outline until the harm question decides it; then its outline redraws in its class colour (public = accent blue, internal = accent2 amber, confidential = accent3 magenta) and keeps that colour wherever it goes. The film opens and closes on the same email with the customer list attached.

story.metaphor: the class is the colour of an item's outline, and it travels with the item
story.setting: a white technical sheet, stations left to right
story.arc: a pause before Send, the three classes by example, a check, the rule, back to Send done right

cast.name: Owner
cast.role: the list's owner, who decides its class (b12)

cast.name: Recipient
cast.role: the one named person who needs the list (b08)

devices.what: the class lives in the outline colour: an item's single outline redraws from grey dashed (unclassified) into its class colour on the spoken class word; public = accent, internal = accent2, confidential = accent3, held the whole film
the laptop email with the customer list attached and the cursor on Send; opens the film and returns at the payoff with the attachment in the confidential colour
three outline trays in the class colours, labelled on their front edges; the items drop into them
the harm question drawn as one line question mark that hovers over an item and decides its class
join material: the next station's white field grows in from the last item's outline (handoff) at section changes; camera pans along the sheet otherwise

value_script.why: open on bare white, only ink and grey lines
confidential is the key mechanism: warm field2 tint, the accent3 line carries the frame
check and transfer back on white
payoff on white; the lift is the confidential line and the approved channel lit

parts.what: a monoline document outline (stroke 3, radius 16, no fill, warm white inside) with a variant per lesson item: press_release (headline bar, body lines, a small 'Press release' label), meeting_notes (bullets, 'Meeting notes'), customer_list (table of name rows drawn as short lines, 'Customer list'), job_advert ('Job advert'), org_chart (a small tree of boxes, 'Org chart'), payroll ('Payroll file'), plain. State: class none (grey muted dashed outline), public (accent), internal (accent2), confidential (accent3); setClass(cls, t) redraws the outline in the new colour along its path over about 0.6 s. Optional small tick mark (pos) for approved. The label is SVG text in ink on the page, at least label size.

a monoline laptop (open, front view) whose screen shows an email: To field reading 'Contractor (new)', a subject line, an attachment chip with a page icon reading 'Customer list' whose outline takes a class colour, a Send button, a pointer cursor that can glide and stop; optional second option row 'Approved channel' with a small padlock, and a note 'Ask the owner'. States: plain (attachment dashed grey), classified (attachment accent3), channel (cursor on Approved channel, Send dimmed).

three open outline trays side by side, outline in accent / accent2 / accent3, labels Public, Internal, Confidential on their front edges; empty or holding items (an item can be placed into a tray and sinks a little).
a large single-line question mark in ink that draws on, can hover over a point and fade; a small 'Harm?' label under it.

the confidential handling props, monoline: a protected channel (a line with a small padlock at its middle that draws from A to B), a folder outline with a padlock that can close, a shredder outline that a page feeds into and leaves as strips, and a file icon that deletes (outline erases to a dashed ghost then gone).
a building outline seen from the front with an open doorway (the threshold line marked), ink line, the outside space beyond it plain white; used for 'stays inside'.
